title: The envelope
summary: Your agent hands you an envelope of cash from a club that wants you, a "loyalty bonus" for saying nice things about them. It's thick. A season on, someone at that club gets caught.

ends.title: Handed it back
ends.text: Your agent gave you a thick envelope from another club and you handed it straight back. When they got caught, you weren't in the story.

ends.title: Kept it
ends.text: You kept the envelope. It's in a drawer. You think about it whenever that club is in the news.

beats.title: The envelope

event.title: The envelope
event.speaker: agent
setup: {agent.name} is in your car park in his car with the engine running. He passes you an envelope through the window. It's thick, and it smells of money. "From a club that likes you. A thank you. For being nice about them in interviews."

say: "Nobody signs anything. Nobody's asking you to move. It's a gift, and gifts are legal, mostly."
"Mostly. Look, nobody's ever been caught for an envelope." That's not true and you both know it.

back.text: He holds it for a second, then puts it on the passenger seat. "Your loss." It's not.

kept.text: Five thousand pounds in fifties. You put it in a drawer and don't spend it.

beats.hint: Your agent has something in his car

event.title: The news
event.speaker: agent
setup: A season on. On the news: that club's director of football has been charged over cash payments to players and agents. They're asking players to come forward.

outcomes.text: You tell them you were offered it and handed it back. It's one line in the report. Your name is on the right side of it.
You take the envelope to the league yourself, still sealed. It doesn't save you from the story, but it helps.
You turn it off. You're not in it. You never were.
You turn it off. The drawer stays shut.
